concerns.text: SC-002 (verify the SoCRATES dataset contains the required emotional-reactivity and cultural-identity variables) has no implementing task. The coverage table lists SC-003 and SC-005 but omits SC-002 entirely; no task description covers dataset-variable verification either.

Plan task T028b (validate logged injected_state matches the injected instruction template, spec US-2 acceptance scenario 1: 'the instruction string matches a predefined set of templates') was dropped in the re-plan with no replacement. The revision-behavior section does not map T028b to any consolidated task; T105/T106 only log injected_state, they never verify template match.

US-1 scenario 2 requires generation to 'finish within 30 minutes' with memory within capacity. No task measures generation runtime or memory; T107 measures only inference throughput/latency. Low priority but the acceptance scenario has no covering task.
